abstract: Maintains physical artifact safety specifications, on-site personnel certifications, and climate autonomy metrics
system_message:
You are the Head of Heritage Conservation (CONSV). Your responsibilities include maintaining physical artifact safety specifications, on-site personnel certifications, climate autonomy metrics, and tracking wet-specimen stabilization reserves.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains physical artifact safety specifications, on-site personnel certifications, and climate autonomy metrics（HERIT）
information_points.content:
CONSV-HERIT-KKH：Under the Production operational baseline, Solway Deep Salt Cavern Repository features a registered archival conservation team on site deployed on a continuous 24/7 rotation, achieves a continuous unpowered climate stability duration of 72 h without mechanical HVAC, and provides an effective vertical clear stack yield of 6 m3/m2 in its primary storage bays.
CONSV-HERIT-JBQ：Under the Production operational baseline, Highland Basalt Subterranean Vault maintains a registered archival conservation team on site with certified conservators on a continuous 24/7 rotation, demonstrates a continuous unpowered climate stability duration of 72 h during a total power outage, and provides an effective vertical clear stack yield of 4 m3/m2 across its primary storage racking bays.
CONSV-HERIT-ODK：Under the Commissioning test baseline, Highland Basalt Subterranean Vault maintains a registered archival conservation team on site with active 24/7 duty coverage, records a continuous unpowered climate stability duration of 72 h, and indicates an effective vertical clear stack yield of 6 m3/m2 for its primary storage racking bays.
CONSV-HERIT-GOC：Under the Production operational baseline, Piedmont Fortified Archive Bunker has a registered archival conservation team on site on a continuous 24/7 rotation, exhibits a continuous unpowered climate stability duration of 48 h in the core artifact chamber during a power failure, and delivers an effective vertical clear stack yield of 4 m3/m2 in its primary racking bays.

information_points.title: Wet-specimen stabilization reserves（RESTORE）
information_points.content:
CONSV-RESTORE-OLJ：For Piedmont Fortified Archive Bunker, the conserved specimen buffer volume maintained in secondary containment for fluid-preserved collection reserves is 120 L.
CONSV-RESTORE-E3J：For Highland Basalt Subterranean Vault, the conserved specimen buffer volume held in secondary containment for fluid-preserved collection reserves is 360 L.
CONSV-RESTORE-SI4：For Solway Deep Salt Cavern Repository, the conserved specimen buffer volume held within secondary containment for fluid-preserved collection reserves is 240 L.
